name: issue-tracker
description: Employer-agnostic Jira workflow: create a ticket with a validated project and issue type, and transition a ticket to a target status using a cached per-project status→transition-id map. Site, project keys, and status aliases come from a machine-local config file, so moving to a new company is a config swap rather than a skill rewrite. Also creates Linear issues against a fixed Why/Repro/Fix/Done-when/Signals template.
